fusions.name: Forager Sortie
fusions.desc: Looses 3 foragers at once, spread apart; each deals 3 damage. They carry 20% of the damage dealt back to you as healing over the following 5 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Hive Aboard
fusions.desc: Sends a hive off your tailboard into the first enemy in its path. It deals 12 damage and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles.

fusions.name: Tireless Rounds
fusions.desc: Restores 4 stamina a second for 6 seconds. For 8 seconds a swarm rides escort beside you, stinging for 3 damage every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Combs Aboard
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 5. When you reach 5, they all spend at once: you are healed for 5% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 8 seconds.
